# Mars Society 2026 — Version 5 Package

Purpose: provide the complete conference deck, speaking materials, evidence controls and reusable harness-skill blueprints.

## Presentation

The Intelligence Layer for Mars: Harnessed Agentic AI for Science, Engineering, and Settlement

21 slides. Exactly 30:00 of programmed speaking time.

## September 2026 source integration

The package now incorporates Bob J Mills’ supplied “The AI Path to Mars” source message. The revised story begins with a stricter premise: knowledge is not execution. The model supplies intelligence; the harness supplies mission capability by combining orchestration, instructions, tools, context, memory, specialist agents, validation and approval.

The deck now:

- Presents a five-stage Mars Harness sequence: Discover, Engineer, Verify, Deliver and Evolve.
- Uses Observed, Derived, Assumed and Unknown as epistemic statuses while keeping provenance as a separate field.
- Makes ground-truth gates and human approval for consequential actions explicit.
- Expands mission memory to preserve evidence, provenance, configuration state, decisions, dissent and lessons learned.
- Grounds the physical-engineering argument in habitats, ISRU, propulsion, power, construction and complex program coordination.
- Recasts slide 15 as a verified MOXIE starting point: 16 oxygen-producing runs, 122 g of oxygen, a most-efficient rate of 12 g/hour and product purity of at least 98 percent.
- Keeps the crew-scale requirements and research request on slides 16–17 explicitly illustrative until reviewed engineering outputs replace them.
- Adds eight platform-neutral, downloadable skill blueprints for Codex, Claude Cowork, Hermes, Gemini, Grok or another governed runtime.

The MOXIE figures are sourced to NASA/JPL. They establish feasibility, not habitat-scale readiness.

## Version 5 visual system

- Alternates Mars imagery with editable, presentation-relevant infographics.
- Uses capability rails, trace rows and progressive step paths instead of decorative tables.
- Preserves the research → engineering → verification → delivery → field-learning loop as the visual spine.
- Keeps every infographic tied to evidence, authority or work-product flow.

## Governing architecture

The package addresses physical, non-software engineering across aerospace, mechanical, electrical, controls, manufacturing and process systems. Its durable principles are harness over model, skills over agents, model and vendor independence, science before engineering certainty, approved outputs only, verification by design, adaptive human/AI responsibility and persistent mission memory.

See `13_Detailed_Initial_Chat_Summary_and_Restored_Concepts.md` for the design record and `14_Source_Integration_The_AI_Path_to_Mars.md` for the new source mapping.

## Version 5 authoritative scope

The attached 21-slide deck replaces the earlier presentation. It frames Mars as a learning-rate problem and organizes the solution around three harnesses—science, engineering, and project execution—joined by a governed digital thread. The package now includes the exact slide transcript, aligned notes, an ISRU/MOXIE completion-loop case study, portable mission skills, mission-memory guidance, adoption guidance, and a knowledge/documentation mind map.
